sources.entry: Intellicode - AI-assisted coding from Microsoft, available in Visual Studio.

summary.name: IntelliCode
summary.one_liner: Microsoft's AI-assisted code completion tool, built into Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code, that suggests whole lines and ranks IntelliSense completions.
use_cases: speed up writing code with whole-line suggestions
keep private code on a local machine while using AI completion
autocomplete C# code in Visual Studio
autocomplete Python or TypeScript in Visual Studio Code
summary.what_it_does:
IntelliCode provides whole-line code completions that use surrounding context such as variable names, functions, and the type of code being written. It runs on the user's machine, which the page says keeps private code private. It also reorders the IntelliSense completion list so the most likely members appear at the top, based on analysis of open-source contributions on GitHub. For some languages, users can add their own custom methods and codebase properties to the recommendations. Support differs by product: Visual Studio covers C#, C++, Java, SQL, and XAML, while Visual Studio Code covers TypeScript/JavaScript and Python, with C# and Python whole-line completion noted as well.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Runs locally so private code stays on the machine
IntelliSense list ranked by patterns from thousands of GitHub open-source projects
Custom methods and codebase properties can be added for some languages
caveats: Language support varies by IDE: whole-line completion is listed for C# in Visual Studio and Python in Visual Studio Code; the full language list is not uniform across both products
